title: Seedance 2.5 US Image to Video
description: US-hosted ByteDance Seedance 2.5 animates still images with synchronized audio and optional end-frame control. Generate videos up to 30 seconds at 480p, 720p or 1080p.

pricing.text: For every second of 720p video you generate, you will be charged roughly $0.5676/second, and for 480p you will be charged $0.2646/second, and for every second of 1080p video, you will be charged roughly 1.396278 per second. Your request will cost $0.02568 per 1000 tokens for 480p and 720p, and $0.02808 per 1000 tokens for 1080p. The number of tokens is given by (height of output video * width of output video * duration * 24) / 1024.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: The text prompt describing the desired motion and action for the video. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: image
inputs.tooltip: The URL of the starting frame image to animate. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP. Max 30 MB.

inputs.name: end_image
inputs.tooltip: The URL of the image to use as the last frame of the video. When provided, the generated video will transition from the starting image to this ending image. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP. Max 30 MB.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.tooltip: Video resolution - 480p for faster generation, 720p for balance, 1080p for high quality.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.tooltip: Duration of the video in seconds. Supports 4 to 30 seconds, or auto to let the model decide based on the prompt.

inputs.name: generate_audio
inputs.tooltip: Whether to generate synchronized audio for the video, including sound effects, ambient sounds, and lip-synced speech. The cost of video generation is the same regardless of whether audio is generated or not.

inputs.name: bitrate_mode
inputs.tooltip: Output bitrate mode. 'high' requests a higher-quality, larger-file encode from the model; 'standard' uses the default bitrate.

inputs.name: codec
inputs.tooltip: 'auto' retains default video codec behaviour; 'H264' uses H.264; 'H265' uses H.265.
